{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = '/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv'
sales_df = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Convert revenue from string to float, handling thousands separators
sales_df['revenue'] = sales_df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Drop refunded orders
sales_df = sales_df[sales_df['status'] == 'completed']

# Check cross-tabulation of channel and customer_segment
cross_tab = pd.crosstab(sales_df['channel'], sales_df['customer_segment'])
print("Cross-tabulation of channel vs customer_segment:\n", cross_tab)

# Compute conversion rates by channel, stratified by customer_segment
conversion_rates = sales_df.groupby(['channel', 'customer_segment'])['converted'].mean().unstack()
print("Conversion rates by channel and segment:\n", conversion_rates)

# Compute overall conversion rates by channel (raw, unadjusted)
overall_conversion = sales_df.groupby('channel')['converted'].mean()
print("Raw conversion rates by channel:\n", overall_conversion)"}
